CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is large enemy scale (20-40 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a SPECIALIST unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Memory Thief, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Major.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: SPECIALIST.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW MEMORY THIEF — A slender blade-limbed figure that steals abilities and memories.

BODY: Slender, tall, blade-thin humanoid — 15-20 feet. The thinnest, most elongated Hollow form. The body is charcoal-black void-stuff, but SHARP — every edge is a blade, every limb is a cutting surface. The form is not muscular or thick — it is KNIFE-LIKE, all edges and points. The body looks like a silhouette made of razors. Negative-space wounds are small, surgical — precise cuts in reality, not ragged tears.

MASK: An empty face-veil — a thin, translucent sheet of void-stuff hanging over where a face should be. The veil is white-grey, almost invisible, showing nothing behind it. No eyes, no features — just the veil and the void behind it. Occasionally, STOLEN GLYPHS flash across the veil — abstract patterns (NOT readable text) that appear and fade, fragments of stolen memories flickering across the face-veil.

BLADE-LIMBS: The arms and legs are blade-edged — the forearms taper to sharp void-edges, the fingers are needle-points. The limbs are not for grasping — they are for CUTTING. Cutting through memories, through abilities, through the connections between a deity and their powers.

STOLEN GLYPHS: Orbits of stolen glyphs circle the Memory Thief's fingers — abstract symbols (NOT readable text, NOT runes) that flicker in and out of existence. These are stolen memories — fragments of divine abilities, consumed powers, erased knowledge. They orbit the fingers like stolen rings, pulsing with cold white anti-light before fading. The glyphs should look like they are being CONSUMED — flickering, dying, being erased as they orbit.

GATE STONE: A thin, sharp sliver of Gate-stone is embedded in the chest — like a knife-blade driven into the void-stuff body. The sliver is dark, sharp, and pulses with cold white anti-light. This is the shard that CUTS memories from deities.

POSE: Standing still, one arm extended with fingers spread, stolen glyphs orbiting the fingers. The other arm hangs at the side, blade-edge visible. The Memory Thief should look like it is REACHING INTO something unseen — stealing from the air itself. The pose is quiet, precise, surgical. Not violent — invasive.

SCALE: 15-20 feet. Camera at medium angle. The Memory Thief should look SLENDER and PRECISE — the surgical instrument of the Hollow, not the brute force. The most intelligent-seeming Hollow creature, which makes it the most threatening.

GROUND: The ground around the Memory Thief is QUIET — fewer cracks, less visible corruption, but the ground looks... WRONG. Like it is MISSING something. The ground has been partially erased — not destroyed, but FORGOTTEN. Patches of terrain are simply absent — not holes, not void, but areas that look like they never existed. Ash falling upward in slow, precise spirals.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment. The space around the Memory Thief should feel EMPTY — more empty than other Hollow environments. Fewer broken structures, fewer fragments — as if the Memory Thief has not just consumed the buildings but the MEMORY of the buildings. The space looks forgotten, not destroyed. Palette: charcoal-black, void-grey, cold white, faint stolen-glyph flickers.

VFX: Stolen glyphs orbiting fingers and flickering across the face-veil. Blade-edge limbs catching anti-light. The body should look like it is PHASING — partially present, partially absent, as if it is stealing its own existence. Anti-light absorption at the highest intensity — the Memory Thief drinks light so efficiently it barely seems to be there.

SILHOUETTE: Slender, blade-thin, arm extended with orbiting glyphs. Reads as a specialist/assassin unit — the thin, precise, blade-like form is the primary identifier. Should look like a scalpel, not a sword — precise, surgical, terrifying because it targets what you ARE, not what you have.
